events.title: Calicut Rock Night
events.description: Experience an electrifying night of live rock music featuring top local bands performing their best original tracks and popular rock anthems. Enjoy powerful vocals, high-energy guitar riffs, and an unforgettable atmosphere filled with music lovers. Perfect for rock enthusiasts looking to unwind, connect with fellow fans, and experience the vibrant local music scene in an exciting live concert setting.

events.title: Theatre: Midnight Tales
events.description: An immersive evening of thrilling drama and captivating performances, showcasing powerful storytelling, emotional depth, and outstanding acting. Enjoy a memorable theatrical experience filled with intense moments, expressive dialogue, and creative stagecraft that will keep the audience engaged from start to finish.

events.title: Calicut Food Festival
events.description: Taste the best of Calicut’s rich culinary heritage with a delightful mix of traditional dishes and popular street food. From aromatic spices and authentic Malabar flavors to modern local favorites, enjoy a food-filled experience that celebrates the city’s vibrant food culture and satisfies every craving.

events.title: Art & Craft Workshop
events.description: A fun and interactive hands-on arts and crafts workshop designed for all ages, encouraging creativity and self-expression. Participants can explore different materials, learn new techniques, and create unique handmade pieces in a friendly and inspiring environment perfect for beginners and experienced artists alike.

events.title: Calicut Comedy Night
events.description: Laugh out loud with the best stand-up comedians as they bring the house down with sharp wit, relatable humor, and hilarious real-life stories. Enjoy an evening filled with nonstop laughter, clever punchlines, and unforgettable performances that promise great vibes and an amazing comedy experience.

events.title: Tech Talks: Future of AI
events.description: Join expert speakers and industry leaders as they explore the rapidly evolving world of artificial intelligence. Gain insights into cutting-edge AI technologies, emerging trends, and their impact on industries, society, and everyday life. Participate in thought-provoking discussions, ask questions, and discover what the future of AI holds for innovation and progress.
